title: 微软项目团队怎样写共同遵守的工作宣言
topic: 微软项目团队怎样写共同遵守的工作宣言

source.title: Team Manifesto - Engineering Fundamentals Playbook
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课使用 Microsoft ISE 工程手册的 Introduction 引言。页面原文有若干非标准或有语法缺漏的表达，精读注释会标出并给出规范说法；它是团队示例，不代表微软全公司的统一做法。
paragraphs: ISE teams work with a new development team in each customer engagement which requires a phase of introduction & knowledge transfer before starting an engagement.
Completion of this phase of ice-breakers and discussions about the standards takes time, but is required to start increasing the learning curve of the new team.

A team manifesto is a light-weight one page agile document among team members which summarizes the basic principles and values of the team and aiming to provide a consensus about technical expectations from each team member in order to deliver high quality output at the end of each engagement.

It aims to reduce the time on setting the right expectations without arranging longer "team document reading" meetings and provide a consensus among team members to answer the question - "How does the new team develop the software?" - by covering all engineering fundamentals and excellence topics such as release process, clean coding, testing.
Another main goal of writing the manifesto is to start a conversation during the "manifesto building session" to detect any differences of opinion around how the team should work.
It also serves in the same way when a new team member joins to the team. New joiners can quickly get up to speed on the agreed standards.
translations: ISE 团队在每个客户项目中都会与一支新的开发团队合作；正式开始前，需要先进行介绍和知识交接。
破冰并讨论团队标准需要时间，但这是让新团队逐步熟悉工作的必要步骤。
团队宣言是一份由团队成员共同使用的轻量级一页敏捷文档，用来概述团队的基本原则和价值观，并帮助成员就技术工作要求达成共识，从而在客户合作结束时交付高质量成果。
它旨在减少团队设定共同预期所花的时间，免去冗长的“逐份阅读团队文档”会议；宣言还会涵盖发布流程、整洁编码和测试等工程实践，帮助成员回答“新团队将怎样开发软件？”并达成共识。
撰写宣言的另一个主要目的，是在共创会议中开启讨论，找出成员对工作方式的不同看法。
新成员加入团队时，这份宣言也能发挥同样的作用。新人可以快速熟悉团队已经约定的标准。

Completion of this phase of ice-breakers and discussions about the standards takes time, but is required to start increasing the learning curve of the new team.

A team manifesto is a light-weight one page agile document among team members which summarizes the basic principles and values of the team and aiming to provide a consensus about technical expectations from each team member in order to deliver high quality output at the end of each engagement.

It aims to reduce the time on setting the right expectations without arranging longer "team document reading" meetings and provide a consensus among team members to answer the question - "How does the new team develop the software?" - by covering all engineering fundamentals and excellence topics such as release process, clean coding, testing.
Another main goal of writing the manifesto is to start a conversation during the "manifesto building session" to detect any differences of opinion around how the team should work.
It also serves in the same way when a new team member joins to the team. New joiners can quickly get up to speed on the agreed standards.

notes.explain: 指团队协作初期，通过正式和非正式交流使新成员了解项目背景、技术栈和工作流程的过程
notes.example: The project includes an introduction and knowledge-transfer phase for the new team.

notes.explain: 轻量级的一页式敏捷文档，概述团队基本价值观和技术期望，帮助团队达成共识
notes.example: Our team manifesto outlines our commitment to quality and continuous improvement in every sprint.

notes.meaning: 减少设定共同预期所花的时间
notes.explain: 原文搭配不自然；更规范的说法是 reduce the time spent setting expectations。
notes.example: A kickoff meeting helps us reduce the time spent aligning expectations.

notes.explain: 在团队协作初期识别成员间工作方式的不同观点，以便及时协调
notes.example: The session helps us identify differences of opinion before development begins.

notes.meaning: 原文想表达帮助新团队逐步熟悉工作
notes.explain: 原文搭配不自然，increase the learning curve 容易被理解为增加学习难度。更自然的说法是 help the new team get up to speed。
notes.example: This guide helps the new team get up to speed before the project starts.

notes.phrase: and aiming to provide a consensus
notes.meaning: 并希望帮助团队达成共识
notes.explain: 原文并列结构有语法缺漏；可改为 and aims to build consensus。
notes.example: The manifesto summarizes our values and aims to build consensus on how we work.

notes.explain: join 是及物用法，此处不加 to；规范表达是 joins the team。
notes.example: When a new developer joins the team, the manifesto helps them get up to speed.

scenario.title: Agree on engineering expectations before a project starts
english: A new engineering team is starting a customer engagement. Members have different expectations for code review, testing, and release practices.
You suggest writing a one-page team manifesto together before development begins. You invite each member to suggest the standards the team needs.
The team discusses differences and agrees on the expectations everyone will follow.
chinese: 一支新的工程团队即将开始客户项目。成员对代码评审、测试和发布流程的预期不同。
你建议大家在开发开始前共同写一页团队宣言，并邀请每位成员补充团队需要的标准。
团队讨论彼此的不同看法，并就大家要遵循的预期达成一致。

firstAttempt.prompt: 新项目团队对发布、测试和代码规范的理解不一致。请用英文建议在开发开始前共同写一页团队约定，并邀请成员补充。
firstAttempt.sample: Could we create a one-page team manifesto together before development starts? Please suggest the release, testing, or coding expectations we should include so we can agree on how to work.
firstAttempt.rationale: 团队共同写一页约定，在开发前对齐发布、测试和代码规范，并邀请成员提出应纳入的标准。

words.collocation: at the start of a customer engagement
words.example: We agree on the team's standards at the start of each customer engagement.
words.translation: 每个客户项目开始时，我们都会对齐团队标准。
words.note: 这里指具体的客户项目或合作期，不只是一般的客户互动。

words.meaning: 学习过程；熟悉新任务所需的时间和难度
words.example: New developers face a learning curve when joining a project.
words.translation: 新开发人员加入项目时，需要一段时间熟悉工作。
words.note: a steep learning curve 通常表示难度较高。原文的 “increase the learning curve” 不自然；可说 help the new team get up to speed。

words.meaning: 敏捷开发中的轻量级文档
words.example: The team manifesto is a lightweight, one-page agile document.
words.translation: 团队宣言是一份轻量级的一页敏捷文档。
words.note: 敏捷开发中使用的简洁、实用的文档，强调可操作性和及时更新

words.example: Let's agree on the technical expectations before coding begins.
words.translation: 我们在开始编码前先对技术要求达成一致。
words.note: 对团队成员在技术实现方面应达到的标准和要求

words.example: A short manifesto can cover engineering fundamentals such as testing and release practices.
words.translation: 简短的团队宣言可以涵盖测试和发布流程等工程基础实践。
words.note: 指软件开发的基本原则、方法和最佳实践

words.example: The new hire was able to quickly get up to speed with our development workflow.
words.translation: 新员工能够快速了解我们的开发工作流程。
words.note: 指迅速熟悉新环境、新项目或新技术的状态

structure.original: ISE teams work with a new development team in each customer engagement which requires a phase of introduction & knowledge transfer before starting an engagement.
analysis: 主语是'ISE teams'，谓语是'work with'，宾语是'a new development team'
状语'in each customer engagement'修饰谓语动词，表示工作发生的场景
关系从句 which 按语法就近修饰 customer engagement；不过整句表达略显含混，源文想说的是每个客户项目开始前都需要介绍与知识交接。
structure.transfer: A new developer joins the project, which means the team needs to explain its review and testing standards.

rewrite.bad: Li, draft the manifesto by Friday. I’ll decide what everyone’s expectations should be.
rewrite.good: Could we write a one-page team manifesto together before development starts? Please suggest the release, testing, or coding standards we should include.
rewrite.translation: 我们能否在开发开始前共同写一页团队宣言？请大家补充我们应该纳入的发布、测试或代码规范。
rewrite.pattern: Could we create [a one-page team manifesto] together before [development starts]? Please suggest [the expectations we should include].

cloze.prompt: Could we write ___ our testing and release expectations together?
cloze.why: write down 表示把口头约定记录下来。

cloze.prompt: Let’s agree on this before the project gets ___.
cloze.why: get underway 表示项目开始推进。

cloze.prompt: The manifesto helps the team reach a ___ on technical expectations.
cloze.why: reach a consensus on 表示就某个问题达成共识。

dictation.text: The development team writes a one-page manifesto before the customer engagement begins.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 项目启动时共同写什么
dictation.why: 抓住共同制定文件的团队、形式和时间。

dictation.text: The session helps team members discuss their different views on testing and release standards.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 成员对速度、质量和预算的不同关注
dictation.why: 听出宣言共创会的作用：讨论成员对工作标准的不同看法。

apply.prompt: 新项目开始前，团队还没对代码评审标准达成一致。请邀请成员共同讨论并记录。
apply.sample: Could we write down our code review expectations together before development starts? We can discuss different views and agree on a shared approach.

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否一起写下测试和发布方面的共同约定？
translationPractice.answer: Could we write down our testing and release expectations together?

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否在项目开始前写下共同约定？
translationPractice.answer: Could we write down our expectations before the project gets underway?

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否就技术工作要求达成共识？
translationPractice.answer: Could we reach a consensus on the technical expectations?

choice.prompt: 团队想用团队宣言对齐技术标准，避免安排冗长的逐份读文档会议。哪种做法最符合原文？
options: The project lead writes a long document with links, and everyone reads it alone.
The team creates a short one-page manifesto together and discusses differences in expectations.
Wait until the customer engagement ends, then write down what each person did.
choice.why: 原文建议宣言保持一页、由团队共同建立，并用共创讨论发现工作方式上的不同意见。

output.prompt: 一位新工程师下周加入团队，还不清楚现有的代码评审、测试和发布标准。请用英文建议把团队宣言分享给她，并说明这有什么帮助。
output.sample: Could we share the team manifesto with Maya before her first code review? It will help her get up to speed on our agreed testing and release standards.
check: 是否建议把已有团队宣言分享给新成员？
是否提到她需要了解的工作标准？
是否说明宣言帮助她快速熟悉约定？
